caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright stoneware jug with a rounded, cylindrical body and a short, narrow neck topped with a small, slightly flared rim. Attached to the neck is a curved handle extending from the upper rim to the shoulder of the jug. The surface of the jug is a muted, light brown color with darker speckling throughout, indicating the texture of the pottery. There are faintly visible blue markings or lettering on the upper left side of the jug, partially obscured by the curvature. Subtle lines suggest surface cracks, most prominently running vertically and branching across the body. The jug sits on a pale, neutral background with a rectangular boundary faintly outlined around it.
title: Stone Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
